question: Do the same ten native Cano train meshes satisfy geometric replay when Poisson triangle-count variation is bounded to 0.01% rather than required to be exact?
method: Repeat M0R from scratch on the unchanged ten fixed accepted-rank-1 train sentinels and unchanged topology/geometry seeds. Preserve exact graph, spline, bounded operation trace, effective geometry parameters, axis and vertex count plus every individual mesh quality check. Change only triangle-count equality to abs(primary-replay)/max(primary,replay) <=0.0001; retain bidirectional nearest-vertex maximum <=0.75 m, AABB endpoint maximum coordinate difference <=0.5 m and surface-area relative difference <=1%.
baseline: Sealed M0R passed S01 and stopped at train S02 solely because triangle counts were 157298 and 157296 (2 faces; 0.001271%). All exact input/axis/vertex, individual mesh, distance, AABB and area checks passed and both complete maps were visually valid.

user_authorization.scope: One M0R2 implementation and execution with unchanged ten train sentinels, twenty native meshes, ten train previews and zero validation/test inspection, LiDAR or training; only triangle-count exact equality changes to relative difference <=0.01%.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the sealed M0R failure review and exact M0R2 single-condition proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Approved M0R2 proposal/card, exact frozen tools, E1/fixed Cano identity, 50/50 M0R, 17/17 V2R and 391/391 V2 evidence match before RUNNING.

The same ten predeclared train sentinels are reconstructed primary/replay with exact graph, spline, operation trace, effective geometry parameters, axis and vertex count; no validation/development-test parent is read or rendered.
Exactly ten primary and ten replay native meshes are generated from scratch with unchanged seeds/method and zero retry, replacement, repair or failed-run asset reuse.
All twenty meshes individually pass the unchanged readability, axis, AABB and component contracts.

Every pair has triangle-count relative difference <=0.01%, bidirectional nearest-vertex maximum <=0.75 m, AABB endpoint maximum coordinate difference <=0.5 m and surface-area relative difference <=1%.
Exactly ten complete primary train maps are produced; output stays within 3600 seconds and 1.5 GiB; all data/training/simulator/M-TARE scopes remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any approval, source seal, frozen identity, import, free-disk, run-state or scope mismatch
Any exact input/axis/vertex, individual mesh or bounded replay criterion fails
Any threshold adaptation, new seed, spare parent, retry, repair, failed-run reuse or validation/development-test inspection would be required
Executor exceeds 3600 seconds or output exceeds 1.5 GiB
expected_evidence: Frozen M0R/V2R/V2/tool/environment identities, exact command, full log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal
Twenty materialization bundles and ten metrics with exact input/axis/vertex and individual mesh audits
Per-pair triangle-count relative difference, nearest-vertex, AABB, surface-area and OBJ hash records
Ten complete train-only maps and explicit zero LiDAR, label, dataset, training, model, trajectory, simulator and M-TARE counts

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; twenty native Cano mesh materializations and read-only replay comparisons; no LiDAR, simulator or training.
